current_scope.purpose: Supporting public registry index for minimized HBCE / IPR proof records, MATRIX AI Audit Trail public references, evidence-pack continuity, and deterministic verification review.
current_scope.public_position: This registry index is an R&D reference surface. It is not a public authority registry, not a regulated certification register, not an eIDAS qualified trust service, not a custodial identity service, and not a production compliance framework by itself.
current_scope.operational_boundary: The registry index publishes hash-only or minimized public proof commitments. It does not store private evidence, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, personal data, client files, regulated identity documents, credentials, secrets, private keys, financial assets, internal endpoints, or sensitive operational payloads.

description: Public R&D registry index for minimized HBCE / IPR proof records and MATRIX AI Audit Trail references. The registry publishes hash-only or minimized public proof commitments and does not store private evidence, identity documents, credentials, secrets, private keys, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, or sensitive operational payloads. If a required hash is absent, malformed, ambiguous, or inconsistent, verification must return INVALID or NON_OPERATIONAL according to fail-closed rules.

source_role.verification_rule: Verification tools must explicitly declare which public source they use. Ambiguous source selection must fail closed.
source_role.interpretation_rule: A registry entry proves only that a public hash reference exists. It does not certify legal validity, cybersecurity assurance, public authority approval, regulated compliance, institutional mandate, or production authorization.

rules.public_hash_interpretation: A present hash means that a public proof reference exists. It does not certify legal validity, cybersecurity assurance, public authority approval, regulated compliance, institutional mandate, or production authorization.
rules.production_interpretation: R&D and public proof entries must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, or production compliance validity unless independently supported by a lawful production framework.

privacy_note: Public identity labels, operator labels, audit labels, or node labels may appear only when intentionally published for attribution, registry readability, and audit continuity. Sensitive identity evidence, private documents, raw personal identifiers, credentials, secrets, private keys, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, production logs, internal endpoints, and non-public payloads must not be stored in the public registry. Public hashes should represent minimized proof commitments rather than raw personal identifiers.

constraints.subject_label: Public minimal label; must not contain private evidence, raw sensitive identifiers, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, secrets, credentials, or internal endpoints

lifecycle.empty_registry_interpretation: An empty entries array means no public proof entries are currently available in this registry file. It does not certify validity, status, authorization, compliance, security, or inactivity by itself.

verification.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, placeholder-based, or inconsistent registry state must not produce VALID.
verification.production_rule: RND_ONLY and RETAINED statuses must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, or legal authorization.
